questions.question: What did King Zedekiah want from Jeremiah in chapter 21?
options: To anoint Jeremiah as a priest of the temple
To inquire of the LORD about the Babylonian threat
To have Jeremiah crown a new king
To ask Jeremiah to lead the army
questions.answer: To inquire of the LORD about the Babylonian threat

questions.question: What two ways did God set before the people in Jeremiah 21?
options: The way of the priest and the way of the prophet
The way of the rich and the way of the poor
The way of Egypt and the way of Assyria
The way of life and the way of death
questions.answer: The way of life and the way of death

questions.question: God said those who stayed in the city would die, but those who surrendered to the Babylonians would live.
Behold, I set before you the way of _____ and the way of death.
I am against you, O Jerusalem, declares the LORD; I myself will fight against you with outstretched _____.
